# fast_float (vendored)

Single-header release of [fast_float](https://github.com/fastfloat/fast_float) v8.3.2
(`fast_float.h` from the release assets), used by `src/reader.hpp` to convert
JSON numbers to `double` with the Eisel-Lemire algorithm. It is used only
inside the library and is not installed.

fast_float is available under the Apache-2.0, BSL-1.0 or MIT license; wjson uses
it under the MIT license (`LICENSE-MIT`).
